# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 24 | **Condition:** very fragmentary

---

**24:1** [...] Your wonderful deeds [...] the-glory-of [...] for You have done [...]

**24:2** [...] and You have revealed the-greatness-of Your power among the-nations [...]

**24:3** [...] to make-known to-all the-living Your mighty-acts, and who shall [...]

**24:4** [...] recount the-measure-of Your glory? And what is he, the-son-of Adam [...]

**24:5** [...] among Your wonderful works? And how shall one-born-of woman [...]

**24:6** [...] stand before You? For he is kneaded from dust [...]

**24:7** [...] and his dwelling is with worms, and he is [...] a form-of clay [...]

**24:8** [...] pinched-off, and to the-dust he shall return at the-appointed-time [...]

**24:9** [...] and what shall clay reply, and that-which-is-formed-by hand [...]

**24:10** [...] and what counsel shall it understand? [...]

**24:11** [...] who can contain [...] Your [...] before You? [...]

**24:12** [...] all the-host-of heaven and [...] the-foundations-of [...]

**24:13** [...] Your truth, and there is none other, and nothing [...]

**24:14** [...] to stand before Your anger, and who shall be-justified [...]

**24:15** [...] in Your judgment? For You alone are righteous [...]

**24:16** [...] and all the-sons-of Your truth You bring [...]

**24:17** [...] into forgiveness before You, to cleanse them from their transgressions [...]

**24:18** [...] in the-abundance-of Your goodness and the-multitude-of Your mercies [...]

**24:19** [...] to cause-them-to-stand before You for ever and ever [...]

**24:20** [...] all [...] Your truth [...] for eternity [...]

**24:21** [...] and in Your covenant You have established [...] the-chosen-ones [...]

**24:22** [...] to walk before You in [...] all the-light-of [...]

**24:23** [...] and You have appointed them for [...] in truth [...]

**24:24** [...] according-to their knowledge, one after another [...]

**24:25** [...] and according-to the-measure-of his inheritance in [...] Your glory [...]

**24:26** [...] and the-more You bring him near, the-more [...]

**24:27** [...] he is zealous against all the-doers-of wickedness and [...]

**24:28** [...] for all who walk with You in [...] truth [...]

**24:29** [...] and their seed before You all the-days-of [...]

**24:30** [...] eternity [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 24 is very fragmentary. The preserved portions continue the Hodayot's themes of divine glory beyond human comprehension and the contrast between clay-formed humanity and the sovereign Creator. "Pinched-off" (qerets) in 24:8 reflects the potter imagery. Line count reduced due to extensive manuscript damage.*
